dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I am a researcher of ancient ruins. I simply have to find a way to get inside and investigate... But how in the world is one supposed to get past a Ruin Guard?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: My acquaintance Doolan, an adventurer, was once injured by a Ruin Guard when he, too, sought to venture inside these ruins. We are discussing how to approach it.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: *sigh* But after hours and hours of discussion, we have made no progress whatsoever...
